name: West Virginia
notes: West Virginia supports digital ID through the WV MiD app, Apple Wallet, and Samsung Wallet. Google Wallet is not currently supported.

wallets.name: Apple Wallet
steps: Open the Wallet app on your iPhone (iOS 15.4 or later required).
Tap the + button and choose 'Driver's License or State ID'.
Select West Virginia from the state list.
Scan the front and back of your West Virginia driver's license or ID card.
Complete the face and motion scan to verify your identity.
Your request is sent to the West Virginia DMV. You'll receive a notification once approved — usually within a few minutes.

wallets.name: Samsung Wallet
steps: Open Samsung Wallet on your Samsung device.
Scan the front and back of your West Virginia driver's license or ID.
The West Virginia DMV will verify and approve your digital ID.

wallets.name: WV MiD
steps: Download the WV MiD app from the App Store or Google Play.
Create or sign in to your West Virginia DMV account.
Follow the in-app prompts to scan the front and back of your West Virginia driver's license or ID.
Your Mobile ID will be available in the app once approved by the West Virginia DMV.
